collected.label: Collected
collected.definition: All money recorded in collections, whatever the state of its weekly report. Voided collections are never counted.
collected.includes: Collections in draft, returned, submitted and approved weekly reports.

approved.label: Approved
approved.definition: Money in collections whose weekly report has been approved by a Finance Reviewer. Voided collections are never counted.
approved.includes: Collections in approved weekly reports, whether routed to the main account or not.
approved.excludes: Collections in draft, returned or submitted reports, and voided collections.

pending_approval.label: Pending approval
pending_approval.definition: Money in collections whose weekly report has been submitted and is waiting for a Finance Reviewer.
pending_approval.excludes: Collections in draft, returned or approved reports, and voided collections.

in_progress.label: In progress
in_progress.definition: Money in collections whose weekly report is still being prepared by the branch or was returned for correction.
in_progress.includes: Collections in draft and returned weekly reports.
in_progress.excludes: Collections in submitted or approved reports, and voided collections.

not_yet_routed.label: Not yet routed
not_yet_routed.definition: Approved money that has not yet been marked as sent to the main account.
not_yet_routed.includes: Approved collections with no routing date.
not_yet_routed.excludes: Collections already marked as routed, money that is not yet approved, and voided collections.

routed.label: Routed to main account
routed.definition: Approved money that has been marked as sent to the main account.
routed.includes: Approved collections with a routing date.
routed.excludes: Approved collections not yet marked as routed, money that is not yet approved, and voided collections.

active_branches.label: Active branches
active_branches.definition: Branches whose status is Active today. Not affected by the month filter.

reports_awaiting_review.label: Reports awaiting review
reports_awaiting_review.definition: Weekly reports submitted and waiting for a Finance Reviewer. Filtered by the month of the report week.
reports_awaiting_review.includes: Weekly reports with the Submitted status.

explain.allTime: No filters: all time, all branches
